description.narrative: Impact: Government effectiveness is increased through evidence-based policy making, development, economic and governance planning, monitoring and evaluation. Outcome: Validated accurate Census statistics that can be used with confidence for planning development outcomes. Development objective: Contribute to the improvement of quality of life of the people by providing the Government and other stakeholders with relevant, reliable, sufficient and timely social, demographic and economic data and information for development planning, policy formulation and service delivery as well as for monitoring and evaluation of development programmes and plans.

Ambassaden i Liberia fick en förfrågan av FN's Befolkningsfond att financiera projektet "National Population and Housing Census" i Liberia med 70 miljoner SEK under perioden december 2018 till december 2022.
Huvudsyftet med stödet är att genomföra befolknings- och bostadsräkningen i Liberia för att således bidra till att förbättra människors livskvalitet genom att ge regeringen och relevanta aktörer uppdaterad och tillförlitlig data om bland annat den sociala, demografiska och ekonomiska dimensionen hos Liberias befolkning. Detta omfattar definitionen av strategier för fattigdomsbekämpning samt utarbetande av sociala och ekonomiska utvecklingsprogram på grundval av uppdaterad statistik och data.
Den totala budgeten för "National Population and Housing Census" projektet är 19 miljoner USD, varav värdlandets egna finansiering uppgår till cirka 6.76 miljoner USD.

The Liberia Embassy received a request from the United Nations Population Fund to finance the National Population and Housing Census project in Liberia with 70 million SEK during the period December 2018 to December 2022.
The main purpose of the contribution is to support the implemention of the National Population and Housing Census in Liberia, thus contributing to improving people's quality of life by providing updated and reliable data to the government and relevant actors, including the social, demographic and economic dimension of Liberia's population. This includes the definition of poverty reduction strategies and the preparation of social and economic development programs on the basis of updated statistics and data.
The total budget of the National Population and Housing Census project is 19 million USD, of which the host country's own funding amounts to approximately 6.76 million USD.

- Developed 14 thematic reports that contain in-depth analysis of different topics/themes of the Census such as, fertility, mortality, migration, poverty, education, disability, agriculture, youth and adolescents, among others.
- Provided national and subnational levels data that informed the development of the National Development Plan, the Arrest Agenda for Inclusive Development (AAID).
- Completed the renovation and expansion of LISGIS ICT, GIS Lab, and Data Processing Unit.
- Acquired High Resolution Satellite Image for data capturing and geo information services. This will facilitate the production of good quality maps for planning and programming.
- Acquired and assigned geocodes to the pre and postwar existing Census Administrative boundary layers.
- Built capacity for 25 LISGIS staff in Applied GIS/Cartographic.
- Updated Enumeration Area (EA) maps with accurate census administrative geocodes combined.
- Topological construction for the purpose of eliminating gaps or overlaps between contiguous EAs/Clans/Districts had been achieved for all 15 counties (EAs must be seamless within the County and National frame).
- Developed the National Sampling Frame. This will facilitate the conduct of future national surveys such as DHS, MICS, HIES, Agriculture Survey, Nutrition Survey among others.
The contribution supported the successful conduct of the 2022 national population census, producing high quality data for national development planning and decision making. The results confirmed a population of 5.25 million, a 33.8% increase since 2008. Most residents (98.6%) live in regular households, with small proportions in institutional settings (1.0%) or homeless (0.4%). Urban areas, especially Montserrado County, saw the highest growth (71.8%).
Key demographic insights: Gender split:6 million females, 2.64 million males Youth dominance: 75% of the population is under 35 24.2% are adolescents (1019) Growth rate:0% annually, suggesting population doubling in 23 years Household size: Declined from 6.2 (1984) to 4.4 (2022).
Disability statistics: Over 534,000 people live with functional disabilities 7% of those aged 5 have some difficulty 2.7% have severe limitations Disability is slightly more prevalent among females than males.
